body.brief: Original badge-free Fenfire 1800 1986 stock RS200-proportioned road coupe; petrol teal/ivory/ochre salvage panels; no competition livery; eight whole-body directions in 4x2 grid; transparent wheel openings, no wheels/shadows/text.

dashboard.brief: Original teal/charcoal/ivory 2994 dashboard; LHD blank left binnacle; no baked gauges, text or wheel; transparent windshield; shared wheel and runtime instruments applied in game.

sourceBitmapEdits: None; original PNG bytes preserved. Native importer handles its normal alpha preparation.
